title: AI-Assisted Full Stack Developer Laravel/Vue/Typescript
description:
Hello developers!



We're building a platform for freelancers, marketers, content creators and small businesses.



We're a small team that moves quickly, uses AI heavily, and focuses on delivering real business value rather than generating code for the sake of generating code.



We're looking for a developer who enjoys solving problems, learning new tools, and using AI as a force multiplier.



## What You'll Work On



* New platform features

* Payment and subscription systems

* AI integrations

* User management

* Community and learning features

* Internal automation tools

* API integrations

* Performance improvements

* Product improvements driven by user feedback



## Tech Stack



Backend:



* PHP

* Laravel

* MySQL



Frontend:



* Vue 3

* TypeScript

* Pinia

* Node



Infrastructure:



* Docker

* Linux

* Bitbucket Pipelines



AI Tools:



* Cursor

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* GitHub Copilot

* Any tools that improve delivery



## Important: AI Usage Is Expected



We are not looking for developers who avoid AI.



We actively encourage:



* Cursor

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Code generation

* AI-assisted debugging

* AI-assisted testing

* AI-assisted documentation



We care about results, quality, ownership, and delivery speed.



We do not care how many lines you type manually.



## What We're Looking For



You:



* Can work independently

* Take ownership of tasks

* Ask good questions

* Propose solutions instead of waiting for instructions

* Are comfortable learning unfamiliar things

* Use AI effectively

* Can explain technical decisions

* Care about maintainable code



Bonus:



* Experience with Vue 3

* Experience with TypeScript

* Experience with Docker

* Experience with payment systems

* Experience with AI APIs



## What We Value



Much more important than years of experience:



* Problem solving

* Initiative

* Reliability

* Curiosity

* Communication

* Ability to learn quickly



A developer with 2 years of experience who uses AI effectively and solves problems independently is often a better fit for us than a developer with 10 years of experience who needs constant direction.



## What We Don't Want



This role is probably not for you if:



* You dislike AI tools

* You avoid learning new technologies

* You need detailed step-by-step instructions for every task

* You only work within a very narrow technical area

* You are looking for a large corporate environment



## Selection Process



Instead of algorithm puzzles or LeetCode tests, shortlisted candidates will complete a small real-world task similar to the work we do every day.



We're interested in:



* Your thinking process

* How you use AI tools

* Code quality

* Decision making

* Communication



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Your hourly rate

3. Technologies you're strongest in

4. Which AI tools you use

5. A brief example of how AI has improved your workflow

6. Links to GitHub, portfolio, or relevant projects





PS: We receive a lot of quick applications from people not even reading the description. Please, use my name in your greeting, otherwise we will not respond to candidates who don't really know what they are applying for.



Starting day: 1st of July (or later upon agreement)



Thanks!

Peter

title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST - SHOPIFY ECOMMERCE (REMOTE, LONG-TERM)
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST - ECOMMERCE (DROPSHIPPING)

Remote | Part-Time | 4-6 Hours Per Day | 7 Days a Week

$3-4 per hour (approximately PHP 209/hour) | Growth opportunities for long-term contributors



-------------------------



This is a long-term role. We are not looking for someone for one month. We want someone we can grow with, give more responsibility to, and pay more over time. Our existing CS team has been with us for years, and we want the same for this new hire.



-------------------------



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will handle customer
 tickets for our Shopify-based ecommerce dropshipping brand. That means working through an inbox of 80 to 100 tickets per shift in Gorgias: order status inquiries, cancellation requests, returns and refunds, damaged or lost package cases, and size or quality complaints. You will use our documented SOPs and reply macros to resolve cases consistently, professionally, and with care.



This is not a chat role, not a phone role, and not a social media role. It is
 ticket handling in Gorgias, every day.



-------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Reply to customer
 tickets in Gorgias using our documented SOPs and reply macros

- Hit team KPIs on First Response Time (FRT) and resolution time

- Coordinate with our Supply Chain and Disputes teams when cases require handoff

- Process refunds, replacements, and partial refunds within the approved decision tree

- Escalate cases that fall outside policy to the CS Manager with a clear summary

- Flag products with recurring complaints to the Quality team on a weekly basis

- Keep clean notes on tickets so handoffs are seamless

-------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE FROM DAY 1



- A full Customer Support SOP covering every scenario you will encounter

- Gorgias reply macros for common situations (cancellations, RTS, damaged items, lost in transit, and more)

- A Risky Products SOP for weekly product quality reporting

- Direct access to the CS Manager for escalations and questions

- An existing CS team to learn from, not a brand new setup

You do not need to invent the playbook. We have built it. You need to execute it cleanly and consistently.



-------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



- Hands-on experience in ecommerce customer support, dropshipping customer support, OR Shopify-based CS (any combination works, dropshipping experience is a strong plus)

- Experience with Gorgias OR a comparable ticketing tool (Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk). Direct Gorgias is preferred but we can train on it quickly if you have strong Zendesk experience.

- Comfort handling 80 to 100 tickets per shift without falling behind

- Strong written English: clear, empathetic, and professional

- Reliable internet and your own computer

Bonus (not required):

- Prior experience handling RTS (return-to-sender) situations

- Familiarity with chargebacks and dispute processes in dropshipping

- Prior experience with EU customers and their return expectations

-------------------------



SCHEDULE - READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



This role is 7 days a week, every week. Our customers
 every day including weekends and public holidays. If you cannot commit to working 7 days a week, please do not apply. We will not make exceptions, and applying anyway only wastes both our time.



You can flex your specific working hours within the day as long as tickets are handled within our FRT target.



-------------------------



COMPENSATION DETAILS



Paid weekly via Wise. Rate grows with performance and tenure, we promote from within for team leads and specialist roles.



-------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected without review.



1. Put the word BAMBU in your subject line. Nothing else is required in the subject.

title: US B2B Cold Caller | $5/hr Base + Bonuses + Commission | Track to Manager | 3 Openings
description:
Are you a confident communicator who wants a REAL career path, not just another calling job?



MSET LLC is a Phoenix-based marketing agency. We run paid ads, lead capture, and CRM automation for US service-based businesses (landscaping, glass repair, cleaning, moving). Our average client retainer is $1,000+/month with 12+ month retention. This is HIGH-TICKET B2B sales. Your bookings drive real revenue, not vanity meetings.



We are scaling our cold calling team and hiring 3 callers right now. The first one to consistently hit numbers AND coach others moves to the Appointment Setting Manager track within 6 months ($3,500+/month).





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Make 80 dials/day to US contractors using our GoHighLevel + Twilio phone system (we provide the US number)

- Run BANT-qualified conversations using our proven outlines (not rigid scripts) to book qualified discovery calls

- Aggressively follow up every interested lead. Most B2B contractors need 3 to 7 touches before booking

- Keep meticulous records in GoHighLevel: call outcomes, callbacks scheduled, pipeline stages updated in real time

- Daily 15-minute team standup, weekly 1:1 with the founder

- Hit 2 qualified bookings per day after the 3-week ramp





COMPENSATION (paid weekly via Wise in USD)



After you pass the paid trial week:



- Base wage: $5/hour x 40 hrs/week = $800/month

- Show bonus: $15 per qualified appointment that actually attends

- Close commission: 10% of first-month retainer (~$100/close average)



REALISTIC MONTHLY EARNINGS:

- Solid tier (3 closes, 12 qualified shows): $1,280/month (~Php 74,200)

- Top tier (5 closes, 17 qualified shows): $1,555/month (~Php 90,200)

- Star tier (8 closes, 25 qualified shows): $1,975/month (~Php 114,500)



Earnings are UNCAPPED. Top performers move to Senior Caller (Month 4) and then Manager track (Month 6+) earning $3,500+/month (~Php 203,000+).





PAID TRIAL WEEK



- 5 working days (Monday to Friday) at $3/hr = $120 total

- Pass criteria: book 3+ qualified appointments by EOD Friday

- If you pass: we move you to the full role ($5/hr base, a 67% pay bump, plus bonuses + commission unlocked)

- If you fall short: we part ways with full trial pay and a clean handshake



Trial pay is intentionally lower than the full role so the only people who push hard during the trial are the ones who actually want the long-term role.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR (in priority order)



1. NATIVE-LEVEL AMERICAN ENGLISH ACCENT. Contractors must not be able to tell you are calling from overseas in the first 5 seconds. A voice sample is required with your application.



2. COACHABLE. We train you on everything: our outlines, GoHighLevel, the BANT framework, objection handling, and the US contractor world. Your ability to take feedback and improve weekly matters more than your prior experience.



3. CONFIDENT. On a cold call, tone wins the first 5 seconds. You sound like a peer professional, not a discount telemarketer.



4. HIGH PAIN TOLERANCE. Cold calling is brutal. You absorb 70+ rejections per day without losing 
ntum.



5. DISCIPLINED + ORGANIZED. You hit dial volume daily without being micromanaged AND you keep ruthless records. Every callback scheduled, every "almost" lead followed up, nothing falls through the cracks.



BONUS POINTS (not required):

- Any sales experience: retail, real estate, insurance, D2C, B2B SDR, door-to-door

- US BPO experience (Concentrix, Teleperformance, Sutherland, Alorica, TaskUs)

- Lead scraping experience (Google Maps,
, LinkedIn, Apollo)

- GoHighLevel familiarity

- BANT, MEDDIC, or CHAMP framework knowledge





WHAT YOU NEED



- Your own laptop (Mac or Windows, mid-range or better)

- Reliable home internet (10+ Mbps, wired preferred)

- Quiet workspace

- 18+ years old





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Lead lists, ready to dial (we scrape + DNC-scrub before handing them over)

- US phone number via Twilio + all call and SMS costs covered

- GoHighLevel CRM access

- Cold call outlines + objection-handling playbook

- USB headset (we ship or reimburse)

- Direct training, weekly coaching, and direct founder access





HOURS



Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday.



Best US calling windows: 7-9am, 11am-1pm, and 4-6pm local US time across Eastern, Central, Mountain, and Pacific zones. For Philippines callers, this maps to roughly 4pm to 8am Manila depending on which US zones you focus on. We will plan your exact window with you during onboarding.



Time tracking: we use Time Doctor on your machine starting Day 1 (standard for US-facing remote call teams). You are paid for tracked active time. Idle time pauses tracking automatically. This protects both of us and ensures fair, transparent pay.



Start date: ASAP.





HOW TO APPLY (all 4 items required)



Send your application to 
 with the subject line "Cold Caller Application - [Your Full Name]".



Include ALL four of the following or your application will not be reviewed:



1. 60-SECOND VOICE RECORDING of you pitching anything (a product, your last role, why we should hire you). Upload as an unlisted YouTube link, Google Drive audio, or Loom video. THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT ITEM.



2. A MEASURABLE METRIC you have improved over time (sales numbers, scores, fitness, anything you tracked and got better at).



3. YOUR WEEKLY PAY EXPECTATION in USD.



4. SCREENSHOT of your home internet speed test from speedtest.net.



NO BPO EXPERIENCE? If you have the voice and the grit but no formal BPO background, write "NO BPO BUT GRIT" at the top of your application. We will prioritize your review.





INTERVIEW PROCESS



1. Initial screen (24 to 48 hours): we review your voice sample and answers.

2. Live video interview (30 minutes via Google Meet) with the founder and tea
mber.

3. Paid trial week.

4. Ongoing role: sign the IC Agreement and join the team.



First 30 complete applications will be reviewed within 48 hours. Apply now.

Job Overview  



We are a U.S.-based personal injury law firm in Washington State focused on traumatic brain injury and other serious injuries. We are building AI tools for real work in medicine and law, not consumer apps or marketing sites.  



For clinics, our platform is designed to help general practitioners and specialists access the kind of insight you would normally need many specialists for—so they can better understand complex cases and make more informed decisions for their patients.  



For law firms, our platform supports lawyers who represent injured people by organizing complex medical and legal information and highlighting hidden errors in how insurance companies and their examiners handle claims. The goal is to make it easier to present clear, evidence?based cases when large insurers try to underpay or deny meritorious claims.



If you want your design work to support professional users whose efforts improve the lives of those they serve —doctors and lawyers—and contribute to more informed decisions and fairer outcomes, this is the kind of product you’ll be helping shape.  



Our AI engineer is already building the core workflows and intelligence. We are now looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) from the Philippines who can turn these ideas into a clear, trustworthy, and easy?to?use product suite. This is a full-time, long-term remote role for a designer who wants to own the product experience end?to?end.

et, Loom, and async tools.

  -  Complex tools or dashboards made simple and straightforward to use.

title: AI/ML Platform Engineer (Work With Lead AI Engineer)
description:
About Us

Important – Location

Compensation

Important Note  

We are also hiring a separate UI/front-end specialist whose main responsibility is to make the interface as cutting edge as the platform but also easy to use. This role can focus primarily on backend, AI workflows, and platform engineering rather than visual design.



Role Overview  

You will be a key contributor in a small, high-impact team, taking substantial ownership of features and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate closely with our lead AI engineer on architecture and patterns, sometimes assisting with complex components, but you’ll also be expected to work independently on well-defined projects from design through deployment.



Key Responsibilities  

- Design, implement, and maintain AI/ML services and workflows (agents, orchestration, data flows, integrations).  

- Collaborate with our lead AI engineer on system architecture and technical decisions.  

- Own end-to-end delivery of features: scoping, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.  

- Integrate with APIs, databases, and internal tools to build reliable, scalable services.  

- Write clean, well-structured, well-documented code.  

- Participate in code reviews and help evolve our engineering standards.  

- Assist with debugging, performance tuning, and refactoring existing components when needed.



Nice to Have – Working With End Users  

- Ability and willingness to patiently guide non-technical users as they learn to use the platform.  

- Comfort running short demos, answering “how do I…” questions, and translating technical concepts into simple language.  

- Empathy for users who are new to AI systems and a desire to incorporate their feedback into product improvements.

- Our AI engineer works in the US time zone because that's when he can reach the end users.



Required Qualifications  

- Based in the Philippines and able to work full-time remotely.  

- Strong experience in Python or a similar language used for AI/ML and backend services.  

- Experience building or integrating with AI/ML systems (LLMs, agents, ML models, or MLOps/platform tools).  

- Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control (Git), code reviews, and CI/CD.  

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker).  

- Comfortable working independently with clear ownership of deliverables.  

- Good written and spoken English; able to communicate clearly in async and live settings.



Preferred Qualifications  

- Experience with LLM frameworks or orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar agent frameworks).  

- Background in building internal tools, platforms, or developer-facing services.  

- Exposure to healthcare, legal, or other professional/regulated domains is a plus (not required).  

- Prior remote work experience with distributed teams.



Work Setup

- Work closely with our lead AI engineer and founder.  

- Long-term role with opportunities to grow into broader ownership and responsibility.



How to Apply

- Links to any relevant GitHub repos, portfolios, or demos

title: B2B Sale Agent
description:
B2B Sales Representatives — International Accounts



We are a fragrance house growing internationally. We are building a small remote team to open and manage new B2B accounts worldwide: perfume boutiques, concept stores, luxury retailers, hotel groups, spas, distributors and premium gift buyers.

We are hiring several people for this role.



What you’ll do

You will own targeted boutiques from first contact to a happy, repeat client.



(1) Research and identify the right buyers, make contact, follow up, qualify, and bring the conversation to a paid order.

(2) Send them via our logistic platform discovery sets of our products. 

(2) Negotiate with patience and discretion. Focusing on building trust, empathy, and affection for the brand. 

We sell the way a luxury house sells: relationship first, no aggressive pressure, no reflexive discounting. 

Every message reflects the brand.



(4) Build and maintain the relationship over time. 

You are the client’s point of contact: responsive, reliable, and present well beyond the first order.

Client will be solicited for evaluating the quality of the relationship. 



(5) Coordinate each delivery and follow it through.

Confirm fulfillment, track the shipment, and make sure the client receives everything correctly.



(6) Keep the CRM accurate, updated, and every account moving.



What we’re looking for



* Excellent written English.

* Strong commercial sense, expressed with tact rather than pressure.

* An understanding of how to conduct yourself with a luxury clientele: courtesy, patience, and respect for the client.

* Genuine organization and reliability. You follow guidelines precisely and you follow up without being asked.

* Comfort with CRM tools and Google Sheets.

* Care for the client after the sale, not only before it.

* Experience in sales, client service, B2B, sourcing, finance, operations, account coordination, or wholesale support.



Compensation

* Base: $5-8/hour, depending on experience, this role is focused heavily on commission by choice. 



Commission

The commission is unusually high by choice as we want to make this extremely motivating. 

(1) Commission: 30% of the net margin on every new B2B account you sourced and convert.

(2) Relationship quality commission: additional commission based of client review of the relationship. 



For context, on the accounts you open:



Account size ? Your commission per order

Smaller account, around $7,500 ? around $675

Mid-sized account, around $14,000 ? around $1,260



Three mid-sized accounts in one month would represent approximately $3,780 in commission, on top of base pay.

A minimum of 2 new accounts per month is expected. 



This role is built so that strong performers can earn well above a standard remote salary.

Commission is paid only on new accounts you sourced, after payment is received and the order is approved. 

It is not paid on existing clients, inbound leads, taxes, shipping, refunds, unpaid invoices, or unapproved discounts.



This role can pay extremely well, but it is reserved for people who are precise, disciplined, brand-safe and consistent. 

Very high upside comes with very high standards of quality.

About us

title: General Accountant
description:
An Accounting Generalist handles a company's day-to-day financial operations. They are responsible for processing payroll, managing accounts payable and receivable, reconciling bank statements, and maintaining the general ledger, to say the least. The role ensures all financial transactions are accurately recorded and compliant with local tax laws and regulations.

• Taxation: Prepare and assist in filing tax returns including withholding taxes, VAT, and income tax and assist in maintaining BIR Tax compliance and related documentation.

• QuickBooks Management: Maintain and manage company’s general ledger in QuickBooks or QuickBooks Online, organized records through chart of accounts, classes, and locations.

• Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate and timely weekly report, monthly financial statements, and annual financial reports, generate profit and loss, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.

• Liquidation & Audits: Reconcile cash advances and liquidation reports, monitor expense liquidation and supporting documents, and prepare accounting records for internal or external audits.

• Commission & Purchasing: Calculate sales commissions accurately, match vendor invoices with purchase orders, and verify pricing agreements.

• Create and improve accounting processes and interna controls

• Develop Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs) for accounting-related concerns

• Establish process flow for all cash requests and financial approvals

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent proven experience).

• Software Proficiency: Advanced, certified proficiency in QuickBooks or any related software and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Math Skills: Strong capability to apply financial formulas, specifically calculating percentages and commissions 

• Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping or accounting experience.



Skills:

• Goal-oriented, self-motivated, and proactive.

• Strong problem-solving and consultative skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

• Exceptional attention to detail: high accuracy in data entry, auditing, and detecting financial discrepancies.

• Strong organizational, communication and presentation skills

• Ability to handle sensitive financial information with strict confidentiality.

title: AI-First Video Editor for Facebook Ads - MUST Know AI Tools (HeyGen, Image Gen, ChatGPT/Claude)
description:
Read this carefully. This is NOT a normal video editing job.



We run a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand and produce
 and Instagram video ads at volume. We want ONE dedicated, long-term editor who is fluent in AI tools. If you can edit but cannot actually use AI to create, this role is not for you. Please do not apply.



You must also be fluent in English. Clear written and spoken English is required, as you will be working closely with us and reading scripts in English.



We write the scripts. Your job is to turn them into finished ads. Your footage will come from many sources: AI generation, stock and online clips, YouTube, Canva, and UGC creators. You need to be comfortable pulling from all of these and blending them into one clean, cohesive ad.



AI is the job. You must already know how to:

. Create talking-head and avatar videos with AI tools such as HeyGen (avatar selection, lip-sync, cleanup).

. Generate B-roll, scenes, and product images with AI image tools such as Nano Banana Pro or Midjourney, including writing precise prompts.

. Use AI tools to build captions and hooks.

. Combine AI footage with sourced footage (stock, YouTube, Canva, UGC) into a finished ad, not just edit clips someone hands you.



On top of AI fluency, you must edit well:

. Cut our scripts into
 and Instagram ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5). Ad length varies widely, anywhere from 10 seconds to 10 minutes, so the skill is knowing where to cut and when, not hitting a fixed runtime.

. Keep it clean and simple. We do NOT want over-edited videos with heavy effects. The right cut at the right 
nt matters far more than fancy transitions.

. Add sound-off captions, music, and SFX where they help, nothing more.

. Nail the first three seconds (the hook) every single time.

. Use direct-response pacing: fast and punchy, NOT slow cinematic montage.



Editing tools: CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or After Effects.



You are not a fit if you only do cinematic, wedding, or YouTube editing, or if you have never actually used AI generation tools yourself. We will test this.



This is a full-time, long-term role. We pay monthly via bank transfer from the US (Wise, Payoneer, or similar, whatever works best for you).



How to apply (read carefully, we filter hard):

1. Start your reply with the word "SCROLL-STOP". Applications without it will be ignored.

2. List every AI tool you have personally used and exactly what you made with each. Be specific. For example: "Used HeyGen to make 40 avatar ads for a skincare brand", not "Familiar with AI".

3. Walk me through how you would take one of our 60-second scripts to a finished ad. Where do you use AI footage, where do you pull sourced footage from, and how do you build the captions?

4. Send your portfolio. It must include ads you actually made with AI tools, not just edited footage.



If you cannot answer questions 2 and 3 with real specifics, please do not apply.

title: Video Editor & AI Content Creator ? Scale With a $1M+/Year Scandinavian Brand (Full-Time, $900-1200/mo + Bonuses)
description:

Start your application with the word "Viking" or it won't be read.

We're a Scandinavian e-commerce brand in pet health that crossed $1M+ in annual revenue in our first year. We have 25,000+ customers. Our ads are what built this — not investors, not luck, not partnerships. Direct response ads on Meta that convert cold traffic into buyers, every single day.

And we're just getting started.

Right now, our biggest bottleneck is creative. We need more ads, faster, better, and we need someone who can own that process alongside the CEO. Not just "edit videos." Actually understand why an ad works, build more of what wins, kill what doesn't, and constantly push the bar higher.

That's you.

This isn't a "here's a brief, make it pretty" job. You'll see real numbers. You'll know which ads are printing money and which ones flopped. You'll understand the strategy behind every creative decision. And over time, you'll go from executing briefs to creating winning concepts on your own.

We want someone who grows into a Creative Strategist — not someone who stays a button-pusher forever.

Where you start:

Video Editor & AI Content Creator — executing briefs, editing ads, building assets.

Where you can go (6-12 months):

Creative Lead — concepting ads, directing UGC creators, owning the entire creative pipeline.

We've seen what happens when we find the right person and give them room to run. That's what we're offering.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO:

Week 1-4 (Onboarding):

Learn our brand, our customer (we'll share our full research), our ad library, and our workflows. Edit 3-5 video ads per week from existing footage and assets. Get familiar with our brand and content pipeline. Go through our editing training program.

Month 2+ (Full Speed):

Edit 5-10 short-form video ads per week 
, Instagram, TikTok). Create UGC-style and testimonial-style edits from raw footage. Build image and video assets using AI generation tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, CapCut AI — we'll train you on our specific stack). Repurpose winning concepts into new variations and formats. Experiment with new AI tools and workflows — then show the team what works. Assist with creative assets as needed 
 banners, thumbnails, simple motion graphics).

KPIs — How we measure success:

Ads delivered on time (deadline = deadline, no exceptions).

Creative hit rate — percentage of your ads that beat our control (we track this).

Volume — consistent output without quality dropping.

Proactivity — you flag problems, suggest ideas, and improve without being asked.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

You're a video editor who's already playing with AI tools because you're genuinely curious. Not because someone told you to — because you can't help it. You've tested Runway, Kling, Pika, Midjourney, CapCut AI, or similar tools on your own time. You understand that AI doesn't replace creativity — it 10x's it.

You also understand direct response. You know that the first 3 seconds of an ad d
 everything. You've watched breakdowns of winning ads. You notice hooks, transitions, pacing. Maybe you've edited ads before. Maybe you've just studied them obsessively. Either way, you get it.



Required:

Strong video editing skills (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut — tool doesn't matter, output does).

Experience editing short-form content (ads, Reels, TikToks).

Hands-on experience with at least 2 AI tools (image gen, video gen, or AI-assisted editing).

Good eye for typography, pacing, and visual hierarchy.

Solid written English for team communication.

Reliable internet and a setup that can handle video editing.

Bonus (will put you ahead):

You can show ads you've edited that actually ran as paid campaigns.

You understand hook ? story ? CTA structure.

Experience with Shopify, Canva, or Figma.

Motion graphics or animation skills.

Experience in pet, health, wellness, or DTC e-commerce.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH:

$900 – $1,200 USD/month base (depending on experience).

Performance bonuses on winning ads (ads that beat our control and scale = bonus for you).

13th month bonus after 1 year.

Salary review at 6 months — if you're performing, you'll be compensated for it.

Clear path from Video Editor ? Creative Lead as we scale.

Paid monthly via EasyPay or PayPal.



THE DETAILS:

Full-time, 40 hours per week.

Flexible schedule — but minimum 3-4 hours daily overlap with Central European Time (CET).

Long-term position — we're building a team, not hiring for a project.

You'll work directly with the CEO. No layers. No bureaucracy. Direct feedback, fast decisions.

Remote — work from anywhere in the Philippines.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY):



Applications that skip any of these steps will be deleted immediately.

Step 1: Start your message with the word "Viking."

Step 2: Send your portfolio OR 3 examples of short-form video content you've edited (ads, Reels, TikToks). If you've created anything using AI tools, include it — it will put you ahead.

— "What AI tool have you experimented with recently, and what specifically did you use it for?"

— "What's a
 or Instagram ad you've seen recently that you thought was really well made? Why?"

Step 4: Record a 60-90 second Loom video introducing yourself. Show your face, tell us who you are, why this role excites you, and what you'd bring. (If you don't know Loom — it's free at 
. This is part of the test.)



HIRING PROCESS:



1. Application review (we read every "Viking" application)

2. Portfolio review — does your work match our standard?

3. Top 5-6 candidates receive a paid test task ($20-30 USD) — a real brief, real footage, real deadline

4. Top 2-3 get a Zoom interview with the CEO

6. Full-time hire

, and X 
).

LinkedIn / TikTok / YouTube / Meta   ·   Google Ads / LinkedIn Ads   ·   Google Analytics / Search Console

title: Remote Sales & Demo Specialist for U.S. SaaS Company
description:
ShyftGrid is looking for a serious Remote Sales & Demo Specialist to help us grow a U.S.-based SaaS platform for property operators, multi-location businesses, workforce teams, and service companies.



This is a remote position with a guaranteed monthly base plus commission, residual income, and growth bonuses. This is a strong opportunity for someone who speaks professional English, is organized, can follow up consistently, and wants to grow with a company instead of only doing short-term tasks.



ABOUT SHYFTGRID



ShyftGrid is a software platform that helps businesses manage teams, locations, scheduling, shift activity, operations, and workforce accountability. Our pricing is based on monthly recurring revenue, so this role is focused on helping us bring in real paying customers.



This is not just a basic VA job. This role is for someone who can help create sales opportunities, communicate with business owners, book demos, support demos, follow up, and help turn interested prospects into paying monthly customers.



COMPENSATION



Starting monthly base:

$500 USD per month



The monthly base covers the regular daily work:

- Lead research

- Finding qualified businesses

- Outreach

- CRM updates

- Booking demos

- Demo support

- Follow-up

- Customer communication

- Pipeline organization



Commission:

35% of the first month collected revenue from customers you help close.



Residual commission:

5% monthly residual for 12 months while the customer stays active and paying.



Important:

There is no separate demo bonus. Demo booking and demo support are part of the monthly base pay. Commission and bonuses are based on real paying customers, not just demo activity.



MRR BONUS STRUCTURE



Bonuses are based on verified monthly recurring revenue, not just the number of demos.



$2,500 MRR active for 60 days = $250 bonus

$5,000 MRR active for 60 days = $500 bonus

$10,000 MRR active for 60 days = $1,000 bonus

$20,000 MRR active for 60 days = $2,500 bonus

$30,000 MRR active for 60 days = $5,000 bonus



Customers must be real paying businesses. Free trials, refunds, chargebacks, unpaid invoices, or fake accounts do not count.



PAY GROWTH



This position starts at $500/month.



After 60–90 days, base pay may increase based on performance and verified revenue created.



Possible pay growth:

$2,500 MRR created = eligible for $650/month base

$5,000 MRR created = eligible for $750/month base

$10,000 MRR created = eligible for $1,000/month base



Pay increases are not automatic. They are based on real results, CRM tracking, consistent communication, and paying customers.



WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR



This role is ideal for someone who:



- Speaks clear professional English

- Is comfortable communicating with U.S. business owners

- Is organized and consistent

- Can work remotely with minimal supervision

- Understands lead generation and sales follow-up

- Can book and support demo calls

- Can learn software quickly

- Can use a CRM properly

- Is motivated by USD income, commissions, and growth bonuses

- Wants a long-term opportunity, not short-term task work



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will help with:



- Finding property managers, cleaning companies, security companies, restaurants, warehouses, home healthcare companies, and multi-location operators

- Researching qualified leads

- Contacting business owners and managers

- Sending approved outreach messages

- Booking demos

- Helping show the software during demos

- Following up after demos

- Tracking every lead and follow-up in the CRM

- Helping prospects understand pricing

- Helping close monthly subscriptions

- Keeping the pipeline organized



MAIN CUSTOMER TARGETS



We are mainly focused on businesses that can pay monthly and have multiple locations, teams, employees, shifts, or operational problems.



Examples:

- Property management companies

- Cleaning companies

- Security companies

- Restaurants with multiple locations

- Home healthcare companies

- Warehouses

- Staffing companies

- Service businesses with field teams

- Multi-location operators



Our Starter plan is $39/month, but the main sales focus is higher-value customers:

Multi-Location Control: $99 per location per month

Operations Pro: $149 per location per month

Enterprise: Custom pricing



The goal is not just to get many small customers. The goal is to help build monthly recurring revenue.



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Strong English communication skills

- Reliable internet

- A quiet place for calls

- Sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or customer support experience

- Ability to work U.S. business hours or partial U.S. business hours

- Ability to use CRM tools

- Ability to follow instructions carefully

- Ability to write professional messages

- Ability to attend video calls when needed

- Ability to track all activity clearly



BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH



- SaaS sales

- Property management

- Real estate support

- Appointment setting

- Cold

- LinkedIn outreach

- CRM management

- U.S. business clients

- B2B lead generation

- Customer onboarding



IMPORTANT RULES



- All leads must be tracked in the approved CRM.

- Commission is paid only after customer payment clears.

- No commission is paid on demos only.

- No commission is paid on free trials, refunds, chargebacks, or unpaid accounts.

- Residual commission continues only while the customer stays active and paying.

- Motion graphics timing

- Icon use

- Sound design

title: Lead Generation and Business Development Specialist
description:
US Panels — Job Description

Lead Generation & Business Development Specialist



Type: Full-Time · Remote

Experience: 3–5 Years

Industry: Commercial Construction / Building Materials



Web Scraping   ·  
 Campaigns   ·   Cold Outreach   ·   CRM Management   ·   Pipeline Reporting



ROLE OVERVIEW



US Panels manufactures insulated metal panel (IMP) systems used in cold storage, warehouses, food processing plants, data centers, and industrial buildings. Our customers are the contractors, developers, engineers, and facility owners who design and build these projects across North America.

The Lead Generation & Business Development Specialist is the engine behind our outbound pipeline. This is a high-activity, data-driven role built for someone who is equal parts researcher, communicator, and organizer. You will identify new industry verticals, build targeted prospect lists through web scraping and research, execute multi-channel outbound campaigns, and ensure every qualified lead is captured and tracked in the CRM. You work closely with the content team and sales team to keep messaging sharp and pipeline moving.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Web Scraping & List Building

• Identify and research new industry verticals and geographic markets for outbound prospecting (cold storage developers, food processing contractors, industrial GCs, data center builders, warehouse owners, etc.).

• Use web scraping tools and research platforms to compile accurate, targeted contact lists — names, titles, company,
, phone, and LinkedIn.

• Leverage tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, or similar platforms to source and verify contact data.

• Continuously expand and refresh prospect databases as new verticals are identified or existing lists age out.

• Segment lists by industry vertical, company size, geography, and decision-maker role to enable precise targeting.


 Campaign Execution

• Build and launch outbound
 sequences targeting segmented prospect lists — cold outreach, follow-ups, and re-engagement campaigns.

• Write or customize campaign copy in coordination with the content team to ensure messaging is relevant, personable, and aligned with current marketing initiatives.

• A/B test subject lines,
 copy, and calls to action to continuously improve open rates and reply rates.

• Monitor deliverability, bounce rates, unsubscribes, and replies; maintain list hygiene and CAN-SPAM compliance.

• Coordinate send timing, frequency, and segmentation to avoid audience fatigue and maximize response.

B2B Outreach — Cold
, Cold Call & LinkedIn

• Execute high-volume, personalized outbound outreach across three channels:
, phone, and LinkedIn.

• Make introductory calls to
-engaged prospects to qualify interest and move them toward a sales conversation.

• Send personalized LinkedIn connection requests and follow-up messages to targeted contacts at priority accounts.

• Maintain a consistent daily outreach cadence and log all activity in the CRM without exception.

• Represent US Panels professionally and build genuine rapport — you are the first human impression for most prospects.

Lead Capture & CRM Entry

• Enter all new contacts, outreach activity, responses, and lead status updates into the CRM accurately and promptly.

• Qualify inbound leads from the website and digital campaigns before passing to the sales team.

• Document lead context thoroughly at the time of handoff: company background, project type, timeline, decision-maker, and any expressed needs.

• Ensure zero leads fall through the cracks — own follow-up cadences until a lead is disqualified or handed off.

Cross-Team Collaboration

• Work closely with the content team to align outbound messaging with active campaigns, blog content, and downloadable assets.

• Coordinate with the sales team on target account priorities, territory coverage, and feedback on lead quality.

• Share insights on which verticals, messages, and contact types are responding so both teams can adapt quickly.

• Participate in regular pipeline and campaign review meetings.

Reporting & Analytics

• Report weekly on outreach volume, open rates, reply rates, calls made, meetings booked, and leads entered into the CRM.

• Track pipeline value generated from BDR-sourced leads and report on conversion at each stage.

• Identify what is working across channels, verticals, and messaging — and what is not — and bring recommendations to the team.

• Maintain a clean, organized view of campaign performance in the CRM and reporting dashboards.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Lead Generation & Sales

• 3–5 years of experience in a BDR, SDR, lead generation, or outbound sales role.

• Proven track record building prospect lists from scratch and converting cold outreach into qualified pipeline.

• Experience selling into or prospecting construction, building materials, manufacturing, or industrial B2B markets is strongly preferred.

Data Scraping & Research

• Hands-on experience using web scraping tools, data enrichment platforms, or research workflows to build contact lists.

• Proficiency with Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hunter.io, or comparable prospecting tools.

• Ability to identify the right contacts within target companies and verify data accuracy before outreach.


 Marketing & Outreach

• Experience writing and executing outbound
 campaigns using HubSpot, Mailchimp, Apollo, Outreach, or similar platforms.

• Comfortable crafting personalized, concise outreach that does not read like a mass
.

• Familiarity with
 deliverability, list hygiene, and CAN-SPAM compliance basics.

CRM & Data Entry

• Proficient in HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or a comparable CRM platform.

• Meticulous about data accuracy — contact records, activity logs, and pipeline stages are always current and correct.

• Highly organized; able to manage large lists, multi-touch cadences, and concurrent campaigns without losing track.

Communication & Collaboration

• Strong written communication — outreach
s are clear, personable, and compelling.

• Comfortable on the phone; able to build rapport quickly with busy construction professionals.

• Collaborative team player who communicates proactively with content and sales counterparts.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience prospecting into cold storage, food processing, data center, or warehouse construction markets.

• Familiarity with commercial construction project timelines and procurement decision-making.

• Exposure to trade shows or industry associations (AGC, GCCA, IARW, BOMA).

• Experience with LinkedIn outreach automation tools (Lemlist, Dripify, or similar).



TOOLS USED IN THIS ROLE



Apollo / ZoomInfo / Hunter.io   ·   LinkedIn Sales Navigator   ·   HubSpot or Pipedrive CRM



Outreach / Lemlist or similar   ·   Mailchimp / HubSpot
   ·   Google Sheets / Workspace



PERFORMANCE METRICS



• Qualified prospects added to CRM per week and month.

• Outbound
 open rates, reply rates, and positive response rates.

• Cold calls made and conversion to booked conversations.

• Meetings booked and handed off to the sales team.

• Pipeline value generated from outbound-sourced leads.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:

1. Resume or CV

2. Brief description of the industries you have prospected into and the tools you used.

3. An example of an outbound
 or campaign sequence you wrote (anonymized if needed).



Applicants with demonstrated success building pipeline from cold outreach in technical or industrial B2B markets will be strongly preferred.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Payable Clerks to join a fast-paced US-based healthcare operations team. • Schedule and process payments via ACH, check, and credit card in accordance with payment terms and company policy.

• Perform credit card reconciliation, matching transactions to receipts and statements on a regular basis.

• Maintain and update the accounts payable ledger, ensuring all entries are accurate and up to date.

• Communicate with vendors to resolve discrepancies, missing invoices, or payment inquiries in a timely manner.

• Assist in month-end closing activities including AP aging reports and account reconciliations.

• Ensure all payments are processed before due dates to avoid late fees or penalties.

• Maintain organized and accurate filing of all AP documentation, both digital and physical.

• Collaborate with the Treasury and Finance teams to ensure proper cash flow management.

• Adhere to internal AP policies and procedures, including the payment threshold authorization guidelines.

 

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• At least 1-3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or a related finance/accounting role.

• Hands-on experience with credit card reconciliation, this is a key requirement for this role.

• Experience working with multiple entities or business units simultaneously.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting or AP software (e.g., QuickBooks, 
, Ramp, or similar platforms).

• Excellent attention to detail and high level of accuracy in data entry and financial processing.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote setting.

• Must have a reliable and stable internet connection, a personal computer or laptop, and an extra monitor to work efficiently in a remote setup.

 

Preferred Qualifications

• Background or experience in healthcare is a plus.

• Familiarity with US-based AP processes, payment methods (ACH, wire transfers, checks), and vendor management.

• Experience with multi-entity or multi-facility accounting environments.

 

What to Expect

Work Environment

• This is a fully remote position. You will be working with a US-based healthcare operations team across multiple facilities and entities.

• You will collaborate closely with the AP team, Treasury, and Finance departments on a daily basis.

• Your schedule will be 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday - reliability and punctuality are essential.

 

Volume & Pace

• This is a high-volume AP environment. You can expect to process a large number of invoices and transactions on a daily basis.

• You will be managing payments for multiple entities simultaneously, so strong multitasking and prioritization skills are a must.

 

Compensation & Benefits

Alongside the messaging, you will help manage client workflows and automations, handle customer service tasks, and keep our systems running smoothly so nothing slips through the cracks. Over time, the right person will take on more responsibility and become a core part of how we operate.



The Schedule

What We Are Looking For

Proficient written English. This is essential. The majority of your work is messaging, so clear, professional, natural sounding communication is non negotiable.

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or another CRM. If you have built workflows, managed pipelines, or worked inside a CRM before, tell us about it.

A background in customer service or messaging. You understand how to talk to people, stay calm, and keep conversations moving.

Stable, reliable internet. This is essential. We need you online and dependable during your working hours.

Reliability and availability. We are looking for someone who can commit to consistent hours, including weekends, without heavy outside responsibilities pulling them away. This is about being dependable for the long term.



How to Apply

We read every application properly, so take your time and put your best foot forward. We look forward to hearing from you.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and ready to be part of a nimble, scrappy team that values impact over hierarchy, iSono Health is the place for you.



At iSono Health, success isn’t just about the work—it’s about the mindset. Join us in transforming healthcare and be part of a team where every voice matters, every idea counts, and every action contributes to a greater purpose.

communication, including phone calls,

 3+ years supporting a C-suite executive, startup or high-growth environment strongly preferred.

iSono Health is building the future of breast care. Our platform, ATUSA,  is the world's first wearable, AI-powered, automated 3D breast ultrasound system. title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry brand using AI influencers. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for short-form videos, character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — training provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen and virality-native illustrated character storytelling. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated. You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



To confirm you've read the full posting, include the phrase "character-first" in your application

Use at least 7 apply points.



Shortlisted candidates move into a paid two-week trial that may convert to a confirmed monthly retainer.

title: AU Mortgage Credit Analyst
description:
About EasyStaff



EasyStaff partners with Australian businesses to provide high-quality offshore team members across mortgage broking, legal, administration, and professional services industries.



We are currently seeking an experienced Mortgage Credit Analyst to support an Australian mortgage brokerage.



This is a senior-level role best suited to candidates with strong Australian mortgage lending experience and the ability to assess, structure, and present loan scenarios across multiple lenders.



Key Responsibilities



Credit Assessment & Scenario Analysis



- Analyse client financials including payslips, income structures, and employment types

- Accurately calculate base income, overtime, and variable earnings

- Interpret lender policies to determine borrowing capacity and loan suitability

- Run and compare multiple lender servicing calculators

- Use Quickli to assess borrowing capacity



Lender Policy & Niche Expertise (Critical)



- Develop a deep understanding of individual lender credit policies and niches

- Identify which lenders are best suited for each scenario based on their policy strengths and risk appetite

- Apply lender-specific rules such as:

      *Overtime treatment (100% vs shading)

      *Self-employed requirements (e.g. 1-year vs 2-year financials)

      *Income verification variations

- Understand and utilise lender niches such as:

      *ANZ – ability to consider 1-year self-employed financials in certain scenarios

      *Macquarie Bank – policy allowing no financials/accountant letters when company income is not being used

- Stay up to date with lender policy changes and proactively apply them to scenarios

- Use policy knowledge strategically to structure deals for approval, not just assessment



As part of your application, please include the names of three Australian lenders you have worked with or are most familiar with.



Self-Employed & Complex Income Analysis



- Analyse self-employed clients across:

      *Sole Traders

      *Partnerships

      *Companies

      *Trusts (including complex and multiple trust structures)

- Interpret financial documents including:

      *Tax Returns

      *Financial Statements

      *Notices of Assessment

- Accurately extrapolate income and normalise earnings

- Understand how to trace business income back to the individual applicant

- Identify add-backs, one-off expenses, and sustainability of income

- Apply lender-specific rules for self-employed income assessment



SMSF Lending (Desirable Knowledge)



- Understand the fundamentals of Self-Managed Super Fund (SMSF) lending

- Identify required documentation for SMSF loan applications including trust deeds, financial statements, and compliance documents

- Support occasional SMSF lending scenarios where required



Loan Structuring & Submission



- Prepare strong, well-structured loan submissions to maximise approval chances

- Draft detailed submission notes tailored to each lender

- Build and present lender scenarios to BDMs for policy confirmation

- Package deals in line with lender expectations and credit appetite



Policy & Compliance



- Maintain a strong understanding of Australian lending policies

- Know where to locate and how to interpret lender policies

- Ensure all applications meet compliance requirements

- Identify risks that may impact approval outcomes



Credit & Financial Analysis



- Analyse bank statements to identify undisclosed debts or liabilities

- Conduct and interpret credit checks

- Understand credit scoring, risk profiles, and lending red flags

- Identify issues that may delay or decline applications



Client & Lender Communication



- Liaise with lenders, credit teams, and BDMs

- Clearly communicate scenarios and follow up on applications

- Maintain professional, clear, and confident spoken English



Attention to detail is important in this role. Please save your resume using the format: FirstName_LastName_CreditAnalyst.pdf



Additional Responsibilities



- Assist with loan processing when required

- Conduct pricing negotiations with lenders

- Order and manage property valuations

- Understand and assess eligibility for Australian first home buyer schemes and grants

- Collaborate with internal team members and contribute feedback



Work Setup



- Full-time remote position

- Australian business hours

- Stable internet connection required

- Quiet work environment required

- Must have backup internet available



Salary



- Competitive salary based on experience

- Please include your salary expectations in your application



Requirements



- Essential Experience

- Minimum 5+ years’ experience as a Credit Analyst (mortgage or banking)

- Strong experience with Australian mortgage lending

- Proven ability to interpret and apply lender policy

- Experience running servicing calculators across multiple lenders



Highly Desirable



Experience with:



Connective

Mercury Nexus

Go High Level (CRM Automation)

ChatGPT and AI tools



Exposure to:



Self-employed and complex lending scenarios

Trust structures and company income analysis

SMSF lending

Demonstrated understanding of lender niches and policy differences.



Technical Skills



Advanced financial analysis skills

Strong understanding of:

Income verification (payslips, overtime, allowances)

Self-employed income assessment

Credit reports and scoring

Bank statement analysis

Ability to identify risks and structure deals accordingly



Soft Skills



Excellent verbal and written English communication

Confident speaking with lenders and BDMs

High attention to detail

Proactive and solutions-focused mindset

Open to feedback and continuous improvement

Team-oriented with a hands-on attitude



What Success Looks Like



High-quality submissions with strong approval rates

Accurate and efficient credit assessments (including complex scenarios when required)

Ability to match clients to the right lender based on niche and policy advantages

Clear and effective lender communication

Strong compliance track record



Candidates who are successful in this role are highly detail-oriented. When answering the final application question, please begin your response with the word "Broker".



Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior-level Credit Analyst who:



Has deep experience in Australian mortgage lending

Has strong knowledge of lender niches and when to use each lender strategically

Understands how to analyse complex structures including companies, trusts, and partnerships

Can break down and attribute income back to individual applicants

Has exposure to SMSF lending concepts and documentation requirements

Thinks like a credit assessor and deal strategist, not just a processor

Knows how to structure deals to fit lender policy strengths

Is confident speaking with lenders and advocating for a deal

Can independently interpret policy and apply it to real-world scenarios



They are:

Detail-oriented but commercially minded

Proactive and take ownership

Comfortable asking questions and giving feedback

Friendly, enthusiastic, and a strong communicator

Adaptable and willing to get their hands dirty when needed



Final Application Question

What do you believe is the most important skill of a successful Credit Analyst, and why?

US Panels is a growing insulated metal panel (IMP) manufacturer serving cold storage, warehouse, food processing, data center, and industrial construction markets. We are building a content engine that educates the construction industry, drives inbound traffic, and establishes US Panels as the go-to authority in our space.

The AI Content Creator is responsible for producing the full range of assets that power our marketing: written articles, blogs, newsletters, social copy, AI-generated images, and video content. This is a modern content role built around AI-assisted workflows — you will use today's best AI tools to create high volumes of quality content efficiently, without sacrificing accuracy, brand voice, or technical credibility. You are creative, organized, and genuinely excited about what AI tools can do when put in the right hands.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



AI-Assisted Written Content

• Produce blog posts, technical articles, and long-form guides (1,500–3,000+ words) using AI writing tools — drafted with AI, refined by you.

• Write and publish content covering IMP engineering, installation best practices, cost comparisons, cold storage design, and industry trends.

• Develop pillar pages, product pages, FAQ content, and downloadable resources (spec sheets, guides, checklists).

• Maintain consistent brand voice and technical accuracy across all written output.

• Repurpose long-form content into short-form assets:
 snippets, social captions, pull quotes, and key takeaways.

AI-Generated Photo & Visual Content

• Use AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL·E, Adobe Firefly, or similar) to create original visuals for blog posts, social media, ads, and landing pages.

• Generate product mockups, facility renderings, and educational diagrams to support technical content.

• Edit and refine AI-generated images to meet brand standards and ensure professional quality.

• Build a reusable visual asset library organized by content type, platform, and use case.

Video Content Production

• Produce short-form video content using AI video tools (Runway, Pika, HeyGen, CapCut AI, or similar) for LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram.

• Create educational explainer videos, product highlight reels, project spotlights, and industry tip content.

• Write scripts and storyboards for video content; coordinate filming when live footage is needed.

• Edit and publish video content optimized for each platform's format, length, and algorithm.

Organic & Evergreen Content

Who We Are

West Coast Living is a top-producing real estate team based in Vancouver, BC, operating under Oakwyn Realty. We specialize in residential resale, presale project marketing, rental property management, and developer-facing listing services. We are a fast-moving, highly collaborative team that takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally.

We are looking for a seasoned Real Estate Virtual Assistant who is ready to grow with us long-term. This is not a general admin role. This is a career opportunity for someone who knows Canadian real estate, speaks the language, understands the systems, and wants to be a real part of a professional team.





The Role

You will be embedded into our team,  attending meetings, communicating directly with agents and clients, and supporting the full transaction and marketing cycle. You will be relied on for accuracy, speed, professionalism, and initiative. If we succeed, you succeed. We believe in recognizing and rewarding the people who show up and deliver.

 with team members and clients

Flag issues proactively — if something is missing, unclear, or time-sensitive, you speak up

What You Need to Bring

Minimum 2–3 years of real estate experience — either in a Canadian real estate office, with a Canadian real estate team, or supporting a Canadian broker or agent remotely

Solid working knowledge of Paragon MLS — including listing entry, status updates, and photo uploads

s, documents, and verbal communication must be professional and clear

Strong Assets:

Experience with Canva for real estate marketing materials

Familiarity with BC real estate specifics: strata, depreciation reports, Form B, PTT, FINTRAC

Work Setup & Availability

This role works Vancouver time (Pacific Standard / Pacific Daylight Time) — Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. This is a hard requirement. Our clients and our market operate on this schedule, and you will be expected to be present and responsive during these hours.

What is your current internet speed? (Please include a screenshot of a recent speed test from fast.com or speedtest.net)

Who Thrives on This Team

You are organized to the point that other people notice. You communicate before you're asked. You read a document all the way through before responding. You notice when something doesn't add up. You are proud of the quality of your work and you take ownership of your file like it's yours.



You want to build something — not just fill a role. You are looking for a team that will invest in you and give you room to grow. You are not looking for a side gig. You are looking for a career.





How to Apply — Read This Carefully

?? Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your subject line must read exactly: "WCL VA – [Your Name] – I Read the Whole Thing"

Any other subject line tells us you did not read this ad.



Step 2 — Your Application

A screenshot of your internet speed test (from fast.com or speedtest.net)





Compensation & What We Offer

$9.00 – $11.00 CDN per hour, full-time (40 hours/week), based on experience and demonstrated Canadian real estate knowledge.



What's Included:

Performance-based increases — if the team grows, your compensation grows with it

13th month bonus (paid annually — this is a standard we honour without exception)

10 paid days off per year

A stable, long-term position with a professional and supportive team environment

Direct access to the team lead and agents — you are not working in isolation



We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the right person. If you bring the skills, the professionalism, and the commitment — we will take care of you and grow together.

Qualified applicants will be contacted for a short written screening, followed by a video interview over Google Meet. We move quickly with candidates who demonstrate they are the right fit.

title: Operations Manager (Credit Repair, Marketing & Real Estate Operations)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We are a dual-pillar business operating at the intersection of real estate acquisition and credit-driven business funding. On the real estate side, we specialize in creative financing — subject-to deals, cold outreach on vacant, pre-foreclosure, and tax-lien properties. Both businesses are growing fast. We are not looking for someone to maintain the status quo. We are building the infrastructure to scale, and we need the right operator at the center of it.



THE ROLE

This is not a coordinator position. You are the operational backbone of two businesses. You will manage talent, oversee execution, own systems, and ensure both pillars perform at a high level — simultaneously. You will be the primary point of contact between leadership and the team. Decisions that used to wait will now have a home with you.

    •    You are the eyes and ears of this organization when it comes to hiring — across every pillar, every role, every verticalActively source, vet, and recruit candidates for open roles across the credit repair arm, real estate arm, and marketing and media arm — without waiting to be directedOwn the full hiring pipeline: job post creation, application review, candidate screening, interviews, and final recommendations to leadershipSource talent through OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, and any other platform necessary to find the right people at the right timeIdentify gaps in the team before they become problems — if a role needs to be filled, you are expected to have candidates in the pipeline proactivelyOnboard all new hires with proper documentation, SOPs, access, and expectations from day oneMonitor new hire performance through a structured probation period and make retention or replacement recommendations accordinglyMaintain a running roster of vetted talent that can be activated when a role opens — the business does not stop for vacancies



SYSTEMS & AUTOMATION

    •    Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and streamline workflows using AI and CRM toolsImplement and optimize CRM automations, pipelines, tagging systems, and reporting dashboardsContinuously improve internal systems and document SOPs as the business scalesServe as the primary point of contact between the founder and the entire team



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



CREDIT REPAIR — EXTENSIVE KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED

    •    Deep, hands-on knowledge of credit repair processes — dispute methods, Metro 2 compliance, goodwill letters, rapid rescore strategies, and credit bureau protocolsAbility to audit a client's credit profile and identify the correct course of action without guidanceExperience managing active credit repair caseloads and ensuring clients move through the pipeline efficientlyIf you cannot perform the work yourself, you must be capable of identifying, hiring, and managing the talent who can — no exceptions



MEDIA & MARKETING — EXTENSIVE KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED

    •    Extensive experience with short-form content creation and strategy — Reels, TikTok-style edits, viral clips, 
s, and carousel postsProficiency with CapCut Pro for video editing — transitions, hooks, captions, sound design, and platform-optimized outputStrong understanding of content batching, scheduling, and maintaining consistent brand voice across platformsKnowledge of what drives engagement, reach, and conversion in the credit repair and real estate nichesAbility to oversee and quality-control a content creator or media VA — and step in to execute if that role is vacantExperience with Meta Ads Manager or paid social campaigns is a strong plus



REAL ESTATE — VAST EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

    •    Extensive real estate operations experience — creative financing, subject-to acquisitions, seller finance, and distressed property targetingHands-on experience with multiple real estate platforms and lead generation portals (see tools list below)Ability to manage and direct VA cold callers, skip tracers, and lead managers toward daily performance targetsStrong understanding of how to identify, qualify, and track motivated seller leads through the full pipelineIf a tool or strategy can improve team performance and pipeline output, you are expected to know it or find it

title: Senior SEO Strategist and Team Lead
description:
# Senior SEO Strategist & Team Lead



## About Us



We are a growing SEO agency focused on helping local businesses dominate Google Search, Google Maps, AI Overviews, and ChatGPT-style search experiences.



We are looking for a highly experienced SEO Strategist & Team Lead who can take ownership of campaign performance, rankings, team execution, and SEO strategy.



This is not a basic SEO role.



We are looking for someone who can identify ranking bottlenecks, develop winning SEO strategies, lead our team, and ensure our clients consistently move toward Page 1 rankings.



---



## Your Mission



Your responsibility is simple:



**Analyze every campaign, identify what is preventing growth, build a plan to fix it, and lead the team to execute it.**



You will be accountable for rankings, traffic growth, local SEO performance, and campaign success.



---



## Responsibilities



### SEO Performance Monitoring



* Review client rankings daily.

* Identify ranking drops and traffic declines.

* Identify campaigns that are stalling.

* Monitor organic rankings, local rankings, traffic, clicks, impressions, and conversions.

* Proactively identify opportunities for growth.



### SEO Strategy & Campaign Planning



* Conduct in-depth website audits.

* Identify what is preventing a website from reaching Page 1.

* Develop SEO strategies that drive measurable growth.

* Build and manage 90-day SEO roadmaps.

* Develop:



  * Keyword strategies

  * Content strategies

  * Internal linking strategies

  * Local SEO strategies

  * Authority-building strategies

  * Website restructuring recommendations



### Team Leadership



* Assign SEO tasks to writers, SEO specialists, link builders, and developers.

* Manage projects through Asana.

* Conduct weekly SEO tea
etings.

* Follow up with tea
mbers to ensure tasks are completed.

* Review completed work and maintain quality standards.

* Adjust campaign strategies based on performance data.



### Technical SEO



* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues.



* Conduct audits using tools such as:



  * Google Search Console

  * Google Analytics 4

  * SEMrush

  * Ahrefs

  * SE Ranking

  * Screaming Frog



* Work directly with developers to implement fixes.



* Personally implement SEO fixes when required.



### Client Strategy & Communication



* Conduct strategy calls with clients.

* Explain campaign performance and next steps.

* Present SEO recommendations and growth opportunities.

* Adjust campaign strategies based on client goals.



### SEO Operations



* Build and improve SEO fulfillment SOPs.

* Build and improve GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) fulfillment SOPs.

* Improve internal processes and campaign workflows.

* Ensure campaigns continue progressing and never stall.



## What We're Looking For



* Proven experience ranking websites on Page 1 of Google.

* Strong Local SEO and Google Business Profile experience.

* Strong Technical SEO experience.

* Strong On-Page SEO experience.

* Strong SEO strategy and campaign planning skills.

* Experience managing SEO teams.

* Experience leading weekly meetings and managing project workflows.

* Ability to diagnose ranking issues quickly and create actionable plans.

* Ability to take ownership and accountability for campaign performance.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



You will be measured on:



* Growth in organic rankings.

* Growth in local SEO rankings.

* Growth in organic traffic.

* Growth in clicks and impressions.

* Growth in Google Business Profile visibility.

* Campaign execution and completion rates.

* Client retention and satisfaction.

* Number of campaigns actively progressing versus stalled.

* Visibility within AI search experiences, including AI Overviews and ChatGPT-style search discovery.



---



## Application Questions



1. How many SEO campaigns have you managed simultaneously?

2. Describe a campaign where you took a site from little or no visibility to Page 1 rankings.

3. Describe a local SEO campaign that achieved significant ranking growth.

4. What metrics do you review daily across active SEO campaigns?

5. If a client's rankings have been stagnant for six months, what is your process for diagnosing and fixing the issue?

6. What SEO tools do you use daily?

7. Please provide examples, case studies, or screenshots demonstrating ranking improvements you have personally achieved.



Bonus: Submit a Loom video auditing a website and explaining what is preventing it from ranking higher and what actions you would take to improve its performance.
